digest_block_size.description: Merkle tree block size in bytes (power of 2; kernel v6.2: must equal page and filesystem block size; kernel v6.3+: ≥ 1024 and ≤ page size)

hash_algorithm.description: Hash algorithm used for Merkle tree: 'sha256' or 'sha512'

salt.description: Salt for Merkle tree hashing as a hex string

for_builtin_sig.description: Format digest for Linux kernel builtin signature verification

compact.description: Print only hex digest (omit algorithm and filename)

out_merkle_tree_path.description: Path to write computed Merkle tree; required only for non-kernel consumers

out_descriptor_path.description: Path to write computed fs-verity descriptor

sign_key_path.description: Path to private key file (PEM) for signing

sign_cert_path.description: Path to certificate file (PEM) for signing; required if key lacks certificate

pkcs11_engine_path.description: Path to OpenSSL PKCS#11 engine (e.g., libp11.so)

pkcs11_module_path.description: Path to PKCS#11 token-specific module library

pkcs11_keyid.description: PKCS#11 URI key identifier; defaults to token’s default key if omitted

enable_signature_path.description: Path to built-in signature file (PKCS#7 DER) for enabling verity

dump_type.description: Type of metadata to dump: 'merkle_tree', 'descriptor', or 'signature'

dump_offset.description: Byte offset into metadata to begin dumping

dump_length.description: Length in bytes to dump from metadata; must be used with dump_offset
